items.title: 68429_Walter P. Thomas oral history interview
items.q: I studied with Timothy... one of the principal things that Timothy taught me was what music was.

ctx.x: That's our progress. That's the only way we can progress. That's the reason I feel so dedicated, and I know you do, to trying to do my end... I just feel sad that perhaps I don't think that young people are trying to take advantage of it like you and I took advantage of it, and I wish they would. And I hope that things like this will help them to take advantage of our experiences that came before them.
Right. Because look what a wonderful experience we had with... I almost said Timothy(?) (?)?

ctx.x: Even your teacher, Timothy, was a Scientist.
A Scientist. I told you, he brought out things, and I understood him so clearly, how he fought.
Then you talked about trying to find your own talents.
